name: Connoisseur
text: Whenever you recruit a blue member, +1 blue.

name: Patroness
text: Whenever a shop member goes to the bottom of the pile, +1 follower.

name: Snob
text: Game end: +1 follower per blue member you have.

name: Window Shopper
text: On Recruit: send 1 shop member to the bottom of the pile, gain 1 of its color. Round Start: send 1 shop member to the bottom of the pile, gain 1 of its color.

name: Restocker
text: Once per game: send the whole shop to the bottom of the pile, then refill.

name: Window Dresser
text: On Recruit: send 3 shop members to the bottom of the pile, then refill.

name: Plus-One
text: On Recruit: recruit again this turn.

name: Doorman
text: Whenever a rival recruits more than once in a turn (swaps count), +1 blue.

name: Trendsetter
text: Whenever you recruit a member, send 1 shop member to the bottom of the pile, then refill.

name: Critic
text: Whenever a rival recruits a blue member, +1 follower.
